_README: Netwise CVE reference dataset for Cisco IOS / IOS-XE (#239).
SHIPPED IN THE REPOSITORY AND NEVER FETCHED. Netwise is air-gapped by
requirement (CLAUDE.md section 5). Any design that phones a CVE API at scan
time is out of scope before it starts, so this file is the whole source of
truth and analysis/cve_data.py opens nothing else.
WHAT A KEY IN `advisories` MEANS, AND WHAT IT DOES NOT.
Keys are IOS TRAINS -- 'major.minor' -- because a running-config's `version`
line carries a train and nothing more precise. The exact release (15.2(4)M6)
appears only in `show version` output, which is runtime state and is not in an
exported config at all.
So a match here means THIS TRAIN APPEARS IN THESE ADVISORIES. It does not mean
the device is vulnerable. Most of these advisories also require a specific
feature to be enabled -- see each entry's `requires` -- and many were fixed in
later builds of the same train. Confirming needs the exact build and the
running feature set, neither of which a config export contains.
THE `assessed` LIST IS NOT DECORATION. A train in `assessed` with no entry in
`advisories` means we looked and recorded nothing. A train absent from
`assessed` means we have no data at all. Those are different claims and the
check must never merge them: the first may show a clean result, the second
must not. That is #239's AC-2 and F-4's whole argument, arriving through a
reference dataset instead of through a check.
EVERY CVE ID BELOW IS REAL AND PUBLISHED. None are invented. `url` is the NVD
detail page, which is derived mechanically from the id rather than transcribed,
so it cannot drift from the identifier beside it.
source: Cisco Security Advisories (cisco.com/go/psirt), transcribed by hand
scope: Cisco IOS and IOS-XE, matched at major.minor train level only

12.4.title: Cluster Management Protocol remote code execution over Telnet
12.4.requires: Telnet enabled for incoming connections (CMP is processed on the telnet path)

15.2.title: Quality of Service subsystem remote code execution
15.2.requires: QoS configured, and UDP port 18999 reachable on the device
